'''Orcon''' was an [[Water/Legends|aquatic]] being who lived underwater on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]]. He rode a [[Devil serpent/Legends|devil serpent]], which he controlled with a [[Orcon's trident|trident]].

He would often invade the [[Underwater Kingdom/Legends|Underwater Kingdom]] to steal [[food pearl]]s from the [[Unidentified finned amphibious species/Legends|Underwater dwellers]].
